LangChaiSeafood
May 2026 • Couples
I had an amazing seafood dinner at Làng Chài Seafood Restaurant in Da Nang! The restaurant is beautifully decorated with glowing lanterns and a lively atmosphere that makes the dining experience even more special. The staff were friendly, attentive, and the service was very fast even when the restaurant was busy.

The seafood was incredibly fresh and well presented. Every dish looked like a work of art. The grilled prawns were juicy and flavorful, the lobster with creamy sauce was rich and delicious, and the crab dish was perfectly seasoned. I also loved the pineapple fried rice and the fresh sashimi platter. Everything tasted authentic and high quality.

The restaurant was crowded with both locals and tourists, which says a lot about its popularity. Great atmosphere, fresh seafood, generous portions, and reasonable prices. Definitely one of the best seafood restaurants in Da Nang. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the city!
